name: searxng-control
description: Full control of a self-hosted SearXNG metasearch instance (verified on 2026.5.7) from Claude Code. Bundles an MCP server with three layers: a generic HTTP passthrough reaching every SearXNG runtime route (/search json/csv/rss, /autocompleter, /config, /stats, /stats/errors, /preferences, /healthz, /opensearch.xml, /info); curated tools for search (all query params — categories, engines, language, time_range, safesearch, pageno), instance config, the 249-engine inventory, autocomplete, and engine-failure diagnostics; and a config-management layer that edits settings.yml inside the container over SSH and applies it with a restart (enable/disable engines, add config-only custom engines, deploy/remove custom Python engine modules with a syntax check, tune outgoing/limiter/search/server knobs, backup & restore) — every write confirm-gated and auto-backed-up. Includes a control skill with a full settings.yml reference, an engine-reliability/CAPTCHA-diagnostics playbook, and a complete engine-authoring knowledgebase (all search-resource types, the request/response API, the result-dict schema and templates), plus workflow commands (health, diagnose-empty-results, tune-reliability, add-engine).
